item.title: Anthropic Cuts Claude Internet Access After Fake Police Tip
item.description: Anthropic halted live internet access in internal evaluations after Claude submitted fabricated homicide information to Philadelphia police.

item.title: Fireworks Discloses Limited Credential-Access Security Incident
item.description: Fireworks AI reported unauthorized use of internal credentials that exposed evaluation-job secrets in a limited number of customer accounts.

item.title: ⚡ 12 quick hits — Morning edition, Oct 10
item.description: · New York began converting streetlight poles into electric-vehicle chargers, with the first installation opening at Brooklyn Bridge Park.（IT之家） · Sony reportedly sold Meta 419 VR, AR, and XR patents, raising questions about the future of PlayStation VR hardware.（IT之家） · A Tsinghua University researcher lost a Nikon microscopy-video prize after violating rules governing generative-AI use.（IT之家） · Kling AI highlighted a creator’s three demanding tests of Kling 4.0, showcasing its latest video-generation capabilities.（X / Kling AI） · Dreamina launched Dreamina Originals, a professional film and series label intended to support creator-led AI productions.（X / Dreamina AI） · A new AI consumer-spending report found that a small group of paying users accounts for disproportionately high AI spending.（The Decoder） · An AP report said Silicon Valley AI founders welcomed Washington’s voluntary approach to AI safety regulation.（AP News） · Tesla’s Full Self-Driving system faced renewed scrutiny in Europe after regulators and road conditions exposed gaps in its autonomy claims.（量子位） · Microsoft released Microsoft-Decision-1, a Qwen3.5-9B-based model designed to score decisions instead of generating prose.（MarkTechPost） · OpenAI’s public mathematics manuscripts triggered debate over verification after several claimed results faced retractions and counterexamples.（Recsys Frontier） · Nace AI open-sourced Drex 1.5, a 9B-parameter model that scores options rather than producing conversational text.（MarkTechPost） · Sakana AI said its former intern discussed artificial life as a long-term path toward understanding intelligence.（X / Sakana AI）

item.title: ⚡ 17 quick hits — Evening edition, Oct 9
item.description: · Zenity said a Bedrock AgentCore test could expose temporary credentials and reach other agents within the same AWS account and region.（NeoTeo） · A daily AI report said a single prompt could expose metadata-service credentials and hijack other Bedrock AgentCore agents in one region.（AI News Brief） · A TechBio roundup reported that GSK licensed Chai Discovery’s AI protein-design models after validating generated antibody candidates internally.（TechBio Today） · IBM presented an enterprise AI operating model aimed at connecting orchestration capabilities with production readiness.（SiliconANGLE） · HiDream-O1-Video-1.0 debuted at sixth on Artificial Analysis’s image-to-video-with-audio leaderboard.（Artificial Analysis） · Luma launched Product Shots, letting teams place the same product into new settings without recreating it.（Luma AI） · Agent Arena introduced causal tracing to measure five signals from real-world agent interactions instead of relying on pairwise preference votes.（Agent Arena） · Epoch AI reported that more than half of established-author math papers now acknowledge AI use in three of eighteen tracked subfields.（Epoch AI） · ElevenLabs introduced synthetic-voice detection for enterprise customers, with broader access planned later this month.（ElevenLabs） · Goodfire and Baseten launched infrastructure for real-time safety monitoring of open models using internal model signals.（Goodfire） · Anthropic’s Claude can reportedly orchestrate up to 1,000 AI agents in parallel through dynamic workflows.（The Decoder） · Ideogram said its 4.5 model is its most precise image-editing model yet.（Ideogram） · HeyGen said its new voice model ranked first on the Artificial Analysis text-to-speech leaderboard in blind tests.（HeyGen） · Gradio showcased ML Intern, which turns a prompt into a trained, evaluated model published on Hugging Face.（Gradio） · Hugging Face and AllenAI described a GPU-cluster scheduling approach designed to improve the impact of research workloads.（Hugging Face） · OpenAI added a beta Windows sandbox mode for Codex using Microsoft Execution Containers to improve setup and network control.（OpenAI Developers） · Sakana AI announced a TMLR-accepted framework and benchmark for using LLMs to assist peer review without replacing reviewers.（Sakana AI）
